title: 情報デザイン学キャリアデザイン（経営情報）
subtitle: Career Design in Information Design (Management Systems)
teachers:
TOKUNAGA Yuichi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
This is an introductory course for first-year students in the Faculty of Information Design including Department of Management Systems and Department of Environmental Design and Innovation. In the course, students will:
(1) learn the disciplines of the Faculty of Informatics and Human Communication and the Department of Management Systems
(2) develop career plans based on their vision of the future.
(3) create a learning plan consistent with their career plans.
advice:
This is an introductory course for incoming freshmen. Students will learn about the various disciplines and devise a plan for their future. Topics will include:
1) Disciplines of the Faculty and the Department: lectures from the Dean, the Department Head, and various professors,
2) Curriculum, education, and research of the Department of Environmental Design and Innovation,
3) Career plans: lectures from alumni, and an exercise in career planning,
4) Motivating for Study, and making learning plans: lectures from the Head of the Department, and a planning exercise.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This is an introductory course for incoming freshmen. Students will learn about the various disciplines and devise a plan for their future. Topics will include:
1) Disciplines of the Faculty and the Department: lectures from the Dean, the Department Head, and various professors,
2) Curriculum, education, and research of the Department of Environmental Design and Innovation,
3) Career plans: lectures from alumni, and an exercise in career planning,
4) Motivating for Study, and making learning plans: lectures from the Head of the Department, and a planning exercise.
